economic_threshold_level.source: ICAR - Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR) & TNAU Agritech Portal (Cotton Sucking Pests IPM)
economic_threshold_level.description: Economic Threshold Level (ETL) is 2 nymphs per leaf (6 per 3 leaves), or Grade II hopper burn injury symptoms.

low.label: Low
low.description: Below 50% of ETL and hopper burn grade <= 1.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: 50% to 100% of ETL, or grade 2 hopper burn appearing.

high.label: High
high.description: At or exceeding ETL (>= 2.0 per leaf / >= 6.0 per 3 leaves) or widespread hopper burn grade >= 2.

high.label: High Confidence
high.description: 15 or more photos with verified foliage clarity

low.label: Low Confidence
low.description: 5 to 7 photos analysed; below target sample size
